{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN, as it's a sentinel for missing data
sales['customer_age'] = sales['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Now, explicitly cast to float and print the raw value
print(float(mean_age_converted))"}
